Team Magma vs Team Aqua

Released March 1, 2004 · 97 cards

Team Magma vs Team Aqua is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on March 1, 2004. Its main set has 95 cards, plus 2 secret rares numbered beyond the set (97 in total). It includes 77 Pokémon, 17 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

22 illustrators worked on Team Magma vs Team Aqua. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (15), Shin-ichi Yoshikawa (8), Atsuko Ujiie (6), Katsura Tabata (6), Mitsuhiro Arita (6), Ryo Ueda (6), Hiromichi Sugiyama (5), Jungo Suzuki (5).
